title: Mail
description: Set up DNS for your own mail server and see what is still missing. Experimental.

install.title: Install a mail server
install.body: Deploys the mox template: SMTP, IMAP and webmail in one container.

overview.title: Setup checklist
overview.hint: Run a check on a domain to fill this in. Anything not checked stays marked as such.
overview.label: Mail setup checklist for {{domain}}

unknown.ptr: Set by your hosting provider. This page cannot read it yet.

dns.title: Domain DNS
dns.noChanges: Nothing to add. These records already exist.
dns.blocked: The plan is blocked by existing records. Fix them at your DNS provider first.

next.title: Next step

step.wait: Wait for the mail server to answer

next.tlsSelfSigned: Self-signed: replace before sending real mail.
next.ctaBody: Shows the records this domain needs, without changing anything until you apply.

ports.title: Mail ports
ports.listLabel: Bind and firewall state of the mail ports
ports.failed: Could not open the mail ports
ports.missing: This mail app does not publish the mail ports. Redeploy it from the current template first.
ports.webStays: Webmail and the account UI keep their own bind ({{bind}}). Opening the mail ports never publishes them.
ports.consequence: Only these four ports get a public bind and a host firewall allow rule. The container is recreated.
ports.certificate: Use a real TLS certificate, not the self-signed one, and keep the server hardened before you open the ports.

mailboxes.title: Mailboxes
mailboxes.needsRoot: Only a root user can do this.
mailboxes.pendingWarning: The mail server was unreachable, so the suspend is not applied yet. It applies on the next successful mail call.

empty.title: No mailboxes yet
empty.claim: Claim a domain above, then add the first mailbox.

mailboxes.deleteBody: Type the address to confirm. Suspending is usually the better choice.

reveal.title: Password for {{address}}
reveal.label: Generated password
reveal.once: Shown once. It is not stored.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.needsMailbox: Add a mailbox first. An alias must point at a mailbox.

queue.title: Queue
queue.empty: Nothing is waiting to be delivered.

hold.title: Restore in progress, mail is held
hold.body: A mail restore holds this app stopped. The platform will not start or change it until the restore finishes or rolls back. Follow the job in the Backup panel.

demo.hint: Local demo mode: nothing here is real and nothing reaches a DNS provider or mail server.

backup.title: Backup
backup.notEncrypted: Backups are off until the server has an encryption key, because they would hold unencrypted mail.
backup.needsWrite: Needs permission to change mail settings.

restore.title: Restore backup {{id}}
restore.warning: Mail goes down while the restore runs, and current mail is replaced by this backup.
restore.conflict: This backup cannot be restored right now: the running mox is older than the backup, or another job is running.

storage.title: Backup storage
storage.secretHint: Never shown again, enter it each time you save.
storage.localOnly: In this release backups are still written to the local folder. The bucket is only checked and saved.

systemEmail.title: System emails
systemEmail.intro: Send invites, password resets, alerts and status page notices from noreply at one of your domains, through this mail server.
systemEmail.replace: Replace the current email provider (disable puts it back)
systemEmail.replaced: Enabled, but the email settings were changed since. Disable to restore the earlier provider.
systemEmail.dnsWarning: Mail to outside recipients will land in spam or be rejected until SPF, DKIM and DMARC pass and the server's reverse DNS (PTR) matches its mail host.
systemEmail.needsRoot: Only an instance admin can change where system emails go.
systemEmail.noDomain: Claim a domain in Mailboxes first.

step.delivered_to_local_queue: Delivered to the mail server queue
